title: External HTTP/3 Peer Harness Verification
verification_method: Build, requirement-home tests, plan-only harness run, parser smoke test, and SpecTrace validation.
scope: Verify that the external HTTP/3 harness surfaces the requested peer/scenario matrix and produces explicit pass/fail/skip results without claiming broad HTTP/3 support.
expected_result: The build and requirement-home tests pass, plan-only execution emits rows for every requested target/scenario pair, the parser emits a Markdown matrix, and skipped rows stay visible. Status "skip" is a first-class result and must not be converted into support claims.
evidence: 2026-05-25: `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors after restore generated assets for the new sample client.
status_summary: Complete for the advisory harness/reporting slice. The generated plan-only evidence proves the matrix and parser surface only; live peer interoperability remains a separate execution and protocol-claim concern.
